meta.description: Drone-derived 3D models of a site for presentation, planning and progress review in Israel.

title: 3D models
lede: A 3D model of the site, for presentation, planning and review.
intro: A 3D model is built from the flight imagery and shows the site as a volume: buildings, ground and obstacles.
The delivery format (mesh, point cloud or a viewable model) is chosen for the intended use. Software names and licence claims are not listed here.
deliverables: A model for viewing or export
Combination with an orthophoto where useful

side.title: Talk about a model
side.text: Describe the site and how you want to use the model.
